## 6. `discord_listener.py` — `on_error` boundary

discord.py's dispatcher calls `Client.on_error(event_method, *args, **kwargs)` on any
unhandled exception in an event coroutine; the default just does
`traceback.print_exc()`, bypassing logging entirely. `DiscordListener.__init__` already
registers every handler via `self.client.event(...)` — register a custom `on_error` the
same way rather than wrapping all 5 handlers individually:
```python
async def on_error(self, event_method: str, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
    log.bind(event=event_method).exception("Unhandled error in Discord event handler")
```
Add `self.client.event(self.on_error)` in `__init__` alongside the other registrations
(after line 63). No changes to the individual handler bodies.

## 8. `CLAUDE.md` — new `## Logging` section (after `## Safety`)

```markdown
## Logging

Loguru is the only logging library (`log = logger` pattern; stdlib `logging` survives
only for the futu-api interop in `brokers/moomoo.py`). Level/field/exception policy
follows the team's Python logging rule; this section fills in the project-specific
pieces that rule defers here.

### CRITICAL conditions

Reserve CRITICAL for a failure that makes a load-bearing shared-state invariant
untrustworthy — not merely "this operation failed":

- **Position drift** that fails the auto-settle check (`safety.py::_positions_pass`,
  the "Position drift" branch, as opposed to the single-holder "Recovered position"
  branch) — broker and books disagree in a way we can't resolve automatically, so
  sizing/exposure math built on the books can't be trusted.
- **A top-level task dies** (`main.py::amain`'s `asyncio.gather(listener, executor,
  sweeper)`) — the process can no longer read Discord, execute trades, or run the
  safety net.

Everything else that fails one operation (an order placement, a Discord notification,
an LLM call) stays ERROR — the rest of the system is still trustworthy.

### Required entity ids per event type

| Event category | Required bound fields |
|---|---|
| Discord message ingestion / LLM read | `trader_id`, `message_id` |
| Signal / trade decision (gating, hold/approve/reject) | `trader_id`, `message_id`, `signal_type` once known |
| Order placement / reconciliation | `trader_id`, `order_id`, `occ_symbol`; `broker_order_id` once assigned |
| Protective leg events | above + `signal_type` = `stop_loss`/`take_profit` |
| Safety sweep alerts | `occ_symbol` or `order_id`; `alert_kind` |
| Dashboard request errors | `path`, `method` |
| Broker adapter internals | `occ_symbol` or `con_id` when available |

Open `logger.contextualize(trader_id=..., message_id=...)` once at the top of
`executor.process_message`/`process_signal` so nested calls (`_handle_buy`,
`_handle_exit`, `_place_and_record`, notify helpers) inherit both fields without
re-binding at each site. `contextualize()` is contextvar-based and asyncio-task-safe.

### Sinks (`only_trades/log_setup.py`)

| Sink | Target | Level | Rotation | Retention |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Console | stderr | `LOG_LEVEL` (default INFO) | — | — |
| Rotating file | `data/logs/only_trades.log` | `LOG_LEVEL` | 50 MB | 14 days |
| Errors-only file | `data/logs/only_trades.errors.log` | ERROR | 10 MB | 30 days |
| stdlib bridge | `logging.getLogger(record["name"])` | all | — | — (keeps `caplog` working) |

`tail -f data/logs/only_trades.log` is the live-log entry point, replacing
`journalctl -u only-trades -f`; systemd will keep journaling stdout in parallel until
`StandardOutput=null` is added to `deploy/only-trades.service` once the file sink is trusted.

### Third-party chatter

`FTConsoleLog` (futu-api SDK, `BROKER=moomoo` only) is silenced via stdlib
`logging.getLogger("FTConsoleLog").setLevel(logging.WARNING)` in `brokers/moomoo.py` at
import time — a genuinely separate stdlib logger, left untouched by the Loguru
migration. `discord.py-self`/`aiohttp`'s own loggers haven't shown up as chatty in this
codebase; if they do under real load, add a matching `setLevel` line here.
```
